headline: NCT WISH's Sion travels Japan with Ji Chang Wook in new show
sub: 'Ojisan to Bishonen' premieres Dec 24 on Japan's TELASA
source: Source: SLL JAPAN, Herald Muse, Sports Seoul
caption:
NCT WISH leader Sion and actor Ji Chang Wook are going on a trip to Japan together in a new travel variety show.

'Ojisan to Bishonen' ("Middle-Aged Man and Pretty Boy") is a 5-episode original co-produced by SLL JAPAN and Japanese streaming platform TELASA. The two, who are 15 years apart, filmed a 2-night, 3-day trip to Yamanashi and Odawara. Episodes 1 and 2 premiere Dec 24 at 9 AM JST, exclusively in Japan.
